units: prices are USD per 1M tokens; context in tokens
notes: Sail /v1/models exposes only id/object/created/owned_by (created is a constant placeholder and is dropped). Sail prices and served context come from docs.sailresearch.com/pricing and /models, not from the API.
Prime /api/v1/models exposes pricing for every model; context_window is null for Prime-hosted Qwen3.5 models.

OpenRouter endpoint prices are the per-endpoint 'pricing' fields as listed; they already include the listed 'discount' (e.g. 0.147 = 0.30 x (1 - 0.51)). Exact duplicate listings (same tag and prices) are dropped.
See docs/PRICING_SOURCES.md for method and caveats.

docs_pricing.windows: asap is the default; balanced and flex are selected per request with the X-Sail-Completion-Window header (see /completion-windows)

google/gemma-4-12B-it.method: one chat/completions request with a ~20K-token prompt, max_tokens=1, 2026-10-11

error.message: input (20019 tokens) + max_output_tokens (1) exceeds safe limit of 15872 tokens for model context window of 16384 tokens (reserves 512 tokens for model-specific formatting)

prime.request_headers: Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, X-Prime-Team-ID: <team_id>, a non-default User-Agent
